mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.5% indicates aggressive monetary accommodation, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that sustains consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) above 12-month moving averages indicate robust economic demand and supply, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO exceed 12mo_MA, or joint Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 5.0% annually triggers aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity that boosts corporate profits and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when GDPC1 growth is positive, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll gains exceeding 200,000 (PAYEMS) signal strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when PAYEMS > 200000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) combined with declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates favorable monetary and economic conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when both INDPRO and FEDFUNDS meet trigger condition, or joint Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017 base) indicates economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year window.
